signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 4 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: Plans that include 0% platform fees are able to process up to $10,000 in gross merchandise value (GMV) per month; above that threshold, custom pricing may apply.
SMS reminders: 10 a month, US & Canada
I lost features I love and used.
unless I pay yearly, there is no custom domain.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 6 reviews (0.6% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Support were slow to respond initially and sent me a troubleshooting guide,
getting zero support. Even worse, getting support from an "Agent"
I sent three follow-up emails in total with no response.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.05/5 vs 4.33/5 all-time (-1.28). 10% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $29 tier lacks 6 of 11 features in the $79 tier.

evidence.quote: Individual Plan ($29): No team members; 10 Integrated calendars; Zoom, Google Meet & Teams links; Email reminders; 1% Platform fee on paid bookings; "Powered by TidyCal" bar on your booking page; Unlimited Bookings per month

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 18.1 years old. Sold on AppSumo 3 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $29 vs a stated $144 regular price (80% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: TidyCal reserves the right, at our discretion, to change, modify or otherwise alter the Terms of Service at any time.
We reserve the right to withdraw or amend this Site, and any service or material we provide on the Site, in our sole discretion without notice.

finePrint.summary: A Lifetime plan is a one-time payment with no renewal, which is good for a deal buyer but does not promise lifetime of the buyer.

quote.text: A Lifetime plan is a single payment with no renewal. You pay once ($29 for Individual Lifetime, $79 for Agency Lifetime) and never see a recurring charge.

finePrint.summary: Even Pro plans with 0% platform fee are capped at $10,000 GMV per month before custom pricing may apply.

quote.text: Plans that include 0% platform fees are able to process up to $10,000 in gross merchandise value (GMV) per month; above that threshold, custom pricing may apply.

finePrint.summary: Subscription purchases can get a full refund only within 7 days, after that they are non-refundable.

quote.text: You may request a full refund within 7 days of your subscription purchase by contacting support. After 7 days, subscription payments are non-refundable.

finePrint.summary: TidyCal does not guarantee refunds for paid bookings made by clients, leaving refund policy to the host.

quote.text: TidyCal does not guarantee refunds for paid bookings and is not responsible for disputes between meeting hosts and their clients.

trials.claim: One-time payment includes all future Lifetime plan updates
trials.claimQuote: Yes. You pay $29 or $79 once and get all future Lifetime plan updates.
trials.reasoning: The terms let the vendor withdraw or amend services without notice, and a lifetime buyer reports new booking fees and another paywall after purchase, so future updates are not guaranteed as included.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to withdraw or amend this Site, and any service or material we provide on the Site, in our sole discretion without notice.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can withdraw or change services at any time, so future updates are not guaranteed for a one-time payment.

exhibits.quote: Now they take 1% of any paid bookings and if I want to remove TidyCal branding I'm told to either pay monthly or buy another LTD for $29!
exhibits.argument: A lifetime buyer reports new fees and paywalls for features after purchase, contradicting all future updates included.

trials.claim: Agency plan includes 10 SMS per month for US and Canada
trials.reasoning: Both pricing exhibits directly state the Agency plan includes 10 SMS reminders per month for US and Canada, with no exhibit undercutting that.

exhibits.quote: SMS reminders: 10 a month, US & Canada
exhibits.argument: The quote states the Agency plan includes 10 monthly SMS reminders for US and Canada.

exhibits.quote: SMS reminders for US and Canadian numbers (10 per month).
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms 10 SMS per month for US and Canadian numbers on Agency Lifetime.

trials.claim: AppSumo offers 60 days to request a refund
trials.claimQuote: AppSumo gives you 60 days to request a refund.
trials.reasoning: The 7-day term shown is for a vendor subscription purchase, not an AppSumo purchase, and the review only says a period lapsed without identifying AppSumo's 60-day policy.

exhibits.quote: You may request a full refund within 7 days of your subscription purchase by contacting support.
exhibits.argument: The vendor's own terms allow only 7 days for a subscription refund, not 60 days.

exhibits.quote: Sadly I went to book for a refund but that time period has lapsed too.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports being unable to get a refund because the refund period had already lapsed.

trials.claim: Product offers simple scheduling and paid bookings for a one-time $29 payment
trials.claimQuote: Simple scheduling and paid bookings for $29, once
trials.reasoning: Although the lifetime license is $29 once, paid bookings on Lifetime also carry a 1% platform fee that the vendor may change, so paid bookings are not covered by the $29 alone.

exhibits.quote: Connect Stripe or PayPal. Clients pay when they book and the money goes straight to you. 1% platform fee on Free and Lifetime.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime paid bookings carry an ongoing 1% platform fee, so $29 once does not cover all costs.

exhibits.quote: TidyCal reserves the right to add or change platform and processing fees for payments at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can add or change payment fees at any time, undermining a fixed one-time price promise.

exhibits.quote: Skip the subscription. TidyCal Lifetime is $29 once.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms a lifetime option for a one-time $29 payment.

exhibits.quote: Connect Stripe or PayPal. Clients pay when they book and the money goes straight to you. 1% platform fee on Free and Lifetime.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms paid bookings where clients pay when they book.

trials.claim: Charges 1% platform fee on paid bookings, Pro has no fee
trials.claimQuote: 1% platform fee on paid bookings, on top of Stripe or PayPal fees. Pro has no platform fee.
trials.reasoning: The 1% fee is supported, but Pro's no-fee promise is materially limited because 0% plans are capped at $10,000 GMV per month and fees may be changed.

exhibits.quote: Plans that include 0% platform fees are able to process up to $10,000 in gross merchandise value (GMV) per month; above that threshold, custom pricing may apply.
exhibits.argument: Pro's no-fee promise is capped at $10,000 GMV per month, after which custom pricing may apply.

exhibits.quote: TidyCal reserves the right to add or change platform and processing fees for payments at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to change platform fees, so Pro having no fee can be taken back.

exhibits.quote: On the Free, Individual Lifetime and Agency Lifetime plans, TidyCal charges 1% on payments processed through Stripe, on top of Stripe's own processing fees. Pro has no platform fee.
exhibits.argument: The quote directly states the 1% fee on paid bookings and that Pro has no platform fee.

exhibits.quote: For payments processed through Stripe (including paid bookings, recurring and subscription bookings, and storefront purchases), TidyCal charges a platform fee of 1% of the amount processed.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms TidyCal charges a 1% platform fee on paid bookings.
